claims.statement: Aiming to build fulfilment centres in large towns quickly to enable delivery in at least 12 hours.
claims.quote: We should do whatever it takes to build fulfilment centres in large towns quickly, as quickly as possible so that we are able to deliver in at least 12 hours. I mean, that's the aspiration.

claims.statement: Expecting the financial year GMA contribution to be equal to or better than FY 24.
claims.quote: With a reasonable confidence, I can say that, this financial year will be equal to or better than FY '24 GMA contribution.
claims.target: equal to or better than FY 24 GMA contribution

facts.statement: Blended average gross margin typically ranges between 14.5%, 15%, and 15.5%.
facts.quote: I think 14.5%, 15%, 15.5%, those are the kind of ranges we play in from a gross margin standpoint.

facts.statement: 29% of store cohorts are located in towns with a population of less than 5 lakhs.
facts.quote: So, we have 29% of our store cohorts in less than 5 lakh population towns.

facts.statement: MMR is fully covered except for a couple of pin codes that are not very serviceable.
facts.quote: This is Vikram, we are present in all but a couple of pin codes, which are actually not very serviceable. But, yeah, MMR, Mumbai Metropolitan Region, we are fully covered.

facts.statement: Wage inflation is increasing rapidly alongside product inflation.
facts.quote: I think we've been all talking about product inflation, but I think at a lower level, wage inflation is also going up rapidly.
